SharingSet.description: Grants every Experience Cloud user assigned the Alliance Client Portal User permission set read access to their own Contact's Account record. A single mapping on Account is all that's needed: Facility__c, Ward__c, Staffing_Request__c and Invoice__c are all Master-Detail (directly or transitively) to Account, so their sharing is "Controlled by Parent" and this one Account-level grant cascades read access down through the whole chain automatically. Facility__c/Invoice__c themselves cannot be targeted directly by a Sharing Set - Master-Detail children have no independently configurable sharing, which is also why they don't appear as selectable objects in Setup's Sharing Set UI. This is the mechanism that lets multiple contacts at the same client Account see each other's requests, without depending on org-specific portal role names.
